body:
Someone reclaims a want and discovers it is load-bearing.

An appetite they denied for years gets acknowledged and immediately starts organizing their decisions: what they accept, what they refuse, what they no longer perform.

With Pluto trine Lilith, people supply the depth and the follow-through to a want that never had either.

Nobody needs a crisis; they surface the material and settle it in one motion.

The shift may look quiet from outside, but people who reclaim a banished want change what they will accept from then on.
